digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and orchestrator modules in LLM workflow and plan_review subsystems
propositions: gate_dispatch.py saturated at 799 LOC with only 1 line of headroom, blocking story 343b which requires threading provider_provenance through finalize_verdict and its three call sites in that file
orchestrator.py at 796 LOC with 4 lines of headroom, blocking the same story's parameter addition to finalize_verdict's fourth call site

plan_review recovery cluster (STEP_* constants, recovery functions, metrics attachment) is a natural seam of ~300 LOC that can be extracted from gate_dispatch into a new plan_review_recovery.py module, leaving gate_dispatch with 271+ lines of headroom

context assembly cluster (assemble_context, related helpers) is a natural ~157 LOC seam in orchestrator.py that can be extracted into context_assembly.py, leaving orchestrator with 154+ lines of headroom
nine modules now sit at or within 20 LOC of the 800-LOC cap, indicating the limit is actively constraining design and documentation quality across the subsystem
